findings.issue: Task ID format `wf-ge-XXXXXXXX` violates validateTaskId() regex `/^wf-[a-f0-9]{8}$/i`. The `ge` infix contains non-hex chars and the total length exceeds 8 chars after `wf-`. This ID will be rejected at write time by any code path calling validateTaskId().
findings.recommendation: Replace with instruction to call `generateTaskId('Guided edit: [description]')` which produces valid `wf-XXXXXXXX` ID. Store semantic label in the `title` field.

findings.issue: Task ID format `wf-tr-XXXXXXXX` violates validateTaskId() regex. Same issue as finding-001. Additionally, the instruction to hash 'triage date + fix count' represents manual ID construction which is explicitly forbidden.
findings.recommendation: Replace with instruction to call `generateTaskId('Fix N triage findings')`. Remove bespoke wf-tr- prefix scheme.

findings.issue: No cleanup path when session is aborted mid-edit. Task created in standalone invocation will remain stuck in inProgress indefinitely, polluting ready.json and causing future active-task checks to find a stale abandoned task.
findings.recommendation: Add abort handling clause: when user issues abort/q, move guided-edit task from inProgress to recentlyCompleted with status 'aborted' or remove it entirely.

findings.issue: No guard for empty fix queue. If all findings are triaged as Create task/Skip/Dismiss with zero Fix now selections, a task is still created and immediately completed with zero actual work, producing misleading audit entry.
findings.recommendation: Add guard: 'If the fix queue is empty (no Fix now selections), skip task creation entirely and proceed to Triage Summary.'

findings.issue: Guided-edit task schema missing required fields: `status`, `priority`, `startedAt`, `createdAt`. Every other inProgress task in the system carries these fields. Incomplete schema may be rejected by validateReadyJson().
findings.recommendation: Add `"status": "in_progress"`, `"priority": "P2"`, `"startedAt": "[ISO]"`, `"createdAt": "[ISO]"` to match the triage task schema.

findings.issue: Triage fix-execution task schema missing `createdAt` field. All other task schemas in the system include this field. Creates structural inconsistency with review-created tasks.
findings.recommendation: Add `"createdAt": "[ISO timestamp]"` alongside `"startedAt"` in the task JSON.

findings.issue: Post-edit validation only covers .js files (node --check). No instructions for .ts/.tsx (npx tsc --noEmit), .json (JSON.parse), or other types. Inconsistent with CLAUDE.md Auto-Validation rule.
findings.recommendation: Expand validation matrix: .js → node --check + ESLint; .ts/.tsx → npx tsc --noEmit + ESLint; .json → JSON parse check; other → skip.

findings.issue: Step 6 (Complete task) runs unconditionally but only applies to standalone invocations. In /wogi-start context (case 1), there is no guided-edit task to complete — task lifecycle is managed by the parent command.
findings.recommendation: Add conditional: 'If a guided-edit task was created in standalone mode, move to recentlyCompleted. If within /wogi-start, skip — parent manages lifecycle.'

findings.issue: Standalone check 'check ready.json for an active inProgress task' matches ANY inProgress task, not just guided-edit tasks. If an unrelated task is in progress, guided-edit attaches its work to the wrong task.
findings.recommendation: Check specifically for a guided-edit task (feature: 'guided-edit'), or always create a new guided-edit task regardless of existing tasks.

findings.issue: Clarification note about no direct file modifications is placed after the integration steps rather than in the opening section. Reduces discoverability.
findings.recommendation: Elevate to a dedicated scope section near the top of the file, consistent with how other commands state their constraints upfront.
